#### Experience has exposed gaps in data ingestion, search, and analytics promised for our workflows

Reviewed on Sep 24, 2026

#### What is most valuable?

Snowflake's data sharing capability with other enterprises is the best feature they offer, which is excellent for us as a software company. Everything else they offer can be done better with other platforms at a cheaper rate. Snowflake's data sharing capability stands out compared to other platforms because it is native to Snowflake. If your customer has Snowflake, it is valuable. You can send your data into Snowflake and then the customer receives it automatically.

However, Snowflake has been the biggest mistake we have made since we started the company. It was a drain on the team from a technical perspective and almost from an emotional perspective. A specific example of how it was a drain on the team includes that we were promised a significant amount of things pre-sale around access to solution architects, support to get us on the project, and technical abilities to simplify our infrastructure. All of these technical abilities were significantly oversold. When it came to setting up meetings and getting help, it took months to get meetings with people who could actually assist us. In the end, when we got the meeting with someone who actually had the technical ability to do the work, he confirmed that they could not actually help us. Since then, Snowflake has only held our feet to the fire for the capacity commitments we made on the commitments that they made to us pre-sale.

I'm in RevOps, so not 100% your typical user. I mostly use Snowflake to pull datasets and stitch things together in SQL: pipeline questions, customer data, whatever came up that week.

Write the query, share them, look at what comes back, access them via CLI, drop a quick chart on it in the worksheet to see if the trend is actually there.
